newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway cuts key interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Norway cuts key interest rates.

text.p: Norway's central bank announced on Wednesday it was cutting its key interest rates, effective Thursday.
It said the overnight deposit rate would be cut to 3.5 percent from 4.0 percent and the overnight lending rate will fall to 5.5 percent from 6.0 percent.
The cut came as no no surprise to the money market which had already discounted a half percentage point fall.
Central Bank governor Kjell Storvik said the move reflected developments in the money and foreign exchange markets.
The crown has risen to its strongest level against Europan currencies since it was floated in December 1992.
This is because the economy is strong and foreign investors have been buying Norwegian currency since short term money market rates have been much higher than in Germany.
